desc:
You just got hired at the movie theater… 🎬

The last showing ended, the boss walked out, and he's back in 90 minutes…

and the entire theater is covered in popcorn. 🍿

Sounds easy… until you notice this theater is hiding something. 👀

🌟 Clean All the Popcorn!

🍿 Clean every last piece of popcorn and trash
🔧 Upgrade your tools to clean faster
🚪 Unlock new parts of the theater
🤫 Hit 100% to uncover the SECRET ENDING

Can you finish the shift before he's back?

Tags: Popcorn, Clean, Cleaning, Movie Theater, Cinema, Trash, Vacuum, Cozy, Satisfying, Secret, Story, Adventure, Coop, Simulator
